inputs: Own recovered RGB-derived cameras, photo-derived masks and sparse points; same retained drill/Bunny inputs. No dataset poses/masks/depths or reference geometry enters reconstruction. Independent scanner is posthoc evaluation only.

common_settings.other_dense_settings: unchanged except explicitly controlled pass count

evaluation.alignment: Frozen prior scanner alignment, camera-centre-only transfer for Bunny, identical for all candidates. No candidate-to-reference fitting. Prior drill reflected fit is ambiguous on near-symmetry and not handedness proof.
evaluation.local_profiles: Same frozen Bunny reference fit/cameras and previously photo-corrected five eye/nose crop definitions; paired coverage and common-ray metrics reported separately. Local absolute values include alignment/scan error; mean head error is in reference coordinates, not independently verified physical units.

fixed_sources.method: In every band-refine call, score the initial surface once. Select up to best_of3 source IDs with anchor NCC>=.55. Where at least2 qualify, hold those IDs fixed across hypotheses and require every selected view to remain NCC-valid. Otherwise ordinary best-of scoring. Sweep unchanged. Original private implementation; no source copied.
fixed_sources.decision: Keep private, reject as a general adoption: all drill thresholds and mean error worsen. Bunny local eye/brow F1 and mean error improve, with mixed five-crop relief and no convincing visual restoration of missing features. Bunny alone is insufficient.

soft_sources.method: Same anchor IDs; allow other sources with a .02 score penalty before best-of ranking. Require at least2 valid views as before, without requiring all anchor-selected views. Ordinary scoring where fewer than2 reliable anchor sources.
soft_sources.decision: Reject: all drill thresholds and mean error worsen, Bunny head F1 and mean error slightly worsen.

fine_anchor.method: Select and hold sources only on subsequent passes at the final actual pyramid level. Earlier passes use ordinary scoring. passes=1,2,2: Bunny has2 finest passes rather than1; drill ends at level1, which already has2 passes. Compare against the same ordinary pass schedule, not only the original one-pass Bunny.

drill_two_pass_control.reason: Drill native-resolution pyramid ends at level1, whose existing pass count is already2. passes=1,2,2 adds no drill pass.

fine_anchor.decision: Reject: all drill thresholds and mean error worsen. Bunny fine-anchor and ordinary extra-pass head F1 both below supported baseline; ordinary extra pass worsens mean error, candidate still worse than baseline.

limits: Reference must already be aligned independently; this script does not align it.
Relief uses separately fitted inverse-depth planes on common rays; also inspect absolute error and coverage.
Pointwise metrics can include scan alignment error. Correlation alone is not feature recovery.

validation.six_object_gate: Not run; general controls rejected on drill/local evidence and no adoption or defaults changed.
validation.browser: No execution for rejected controls; previous production browser evidence unchanged.

conclusion: No general source-selection policy adopted. Strict anchoring is a promising Bunny-only measurement, but missing eyes/nose are not convincingly restored and all three policies damage drill geometry. Source switching is allowed by current best-of code; these experiments do not establish it as the cause of all false peaks or prove source selection cannot help.
next_focus: Source reliability must accommodate depth/camera uncertainty and changing visibility. Avoid another blind fixed-view or constant-preference policy; investigate local photometric patch support and the errors it induces before a new adoption.
